name: RSC
subtitle: RuneScape Classic on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
description:
A native RuneScape Classic client built on the 2003scape rsc-c client, with a touch-first interface. Plays RSC Preservation and other Open-RSC worlds, and 2001Scape's May 2001 game. Includes an Apple Watch app, which plays through rsc-relay (see the README).

An unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Jagex. Source and license (GNU AGPL v3.0): https://github.com/amadesa/rsc-swift
